_source_note: State-specific branch hand-curated from real UKPSC syllabus research (RESEARCH-08, 2026-09-06) — coaching-aggregated secondary sources (Drishti IAS, pscnotes, examsuchana), not the primary official PDF text directly. Uttarakhand's official syllabus is unusually detailed for a state PCS (named dynasties, named movements) so this branch has more real granularity than the other 3 states — not padded, just what the source material actually specified. Generic GS content overlaps upsc_prelims_gs heavily and is linked via reused_topics, not re-created. Note: UKPSC states a minimum 1/3rd of Prelims questions reference Uttarakhand directly — the heaviest state-specific weighting found among the 4 states researched.
